note: One sign-in for the Control Centre: the superadmin password unlocks the dashboard and the embedded superadmin console together (sessionStorage hand-off to the console iframe); the classic Control Centre password stays dashboard-only. Superadmin and Control Centre sign-ins now verify through the new verifySuperadminPassword callable, because the strict rules no longer serve config/superadmin_hash to browsers (a readable hash is an offline brute-force target).
